whyItMatters: load evaluates strings as lua code, so untrusted input reaching it becomes code injection.
actions: Replace load with a data format parser instead of chunk loading so untrusted input stays data, never code.
If evaluation must stay, isolate it in a sandbox without file, network, or credential access.
Re-run the scan and confirm no load call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no load reachable from untrusted input, and injection probes stay inert data.
